**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The IBM/MSL IP regime already sits at or above our preferred position:

- **§13.1 (p0197–p0198):** MSL assigns, and IBM owns, all intellectual and industrial property in the hardware, software, design and documentation of all Products, plus any MSL invention on Products or on IBM processes/systems used in performance. MSL keeps only a use right for performing the Agreement. No joint ownership, no assignment of our IP.
- **§13.3(a) (p0208):** Nothing grants MSL rights in IBM's pre-existing IP except a royalty-free right to use disclosed confidential information solely to manufacture Products for IBM; any further licence needs a separate signed IBM agreement.
- **§13.2 (p0202–p0204):** Our information stays ours under the AECI and must be returned on request.
- **Tooling:** IBM-furnished or IBM-paid tools "become and remain the property of IBM" (p1105); MSL owning generic common production tooling (p1088) is acceptable vendor-side ownership.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged as deviations: no express perpetual licence-back of MSL pre-existing IP embedded in Products, and no separately labelled Customer Data ownership sentence — minor sub-elements only, immaterial given the breadth of the assignment to IBM.
